description: Header file defining thread helper classes and functions for testing threading behavior in the starboard namespace, including a TestSemaphore class, thread entry points, and an abstract thread class.

classes.name: TestSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore class for thread synchronization in tests.

classes.name: WaiterContext
classes.description: A struct managing waiter synchronization with condition variables.

classes.name: TakeThenSignalContext
classes.description: A struct combining a semaphore and synchronization primitives for specific test scenarios.

classes.name: AbstractTestThread
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating test threads using Starboard threading API.

methods.name: TestSemaphore()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing permits to zero.

methods.name: TestSemaphore(int initial_thread_permits)
methods.description: Constructor initializing permits to a specified value.

methods.name: Put()
methods.description: Increases permits and signals waiting threads.

methods.name: Take()
methods.description: Blocks until permits are available, then decrements permits.

methods.name: TakeTry()
methods.description: Attempts to decrement permits without blocking.

methods.name: ToVoid(intptr_t value)
methods.description: Converts an integer to void pointer.

methods.name: FromVoid(void* value)
methods.description: Converts a void pointer back to integer.

methods.name: Wait()
methods.description: Waits on condition variable, increments unreturned_waiters.

methods.name: WaitForReturnSignal()
methods.description: Waits until unreturned_waiters > 0, then takes one.

methods.name: Run()
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be overridden by subclasses to define thread behavior.
